CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jobs_public (
  id          BIGINT      GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  company     TEXT        NOT NULL,
  title       TEXT        NOT NULL,
  city        TEXT,
  job_type    TEXT        DEFAULT '实习',
  industry    TEXT        DEFAULT '互联网',
  education   TEXT,
  salary      TEXT,
  source      TEXT,
  url         TEXT,
  jd_text     TEXT,
  tags        TEXT[],
  deadline    DATE,
  posted_at   TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)
COMMENT ON TABLE jobs_public IS '岗位广场：公共岗位库，所有登录用户只读，仅服务端可写'
ALTER TABLE jobs_public ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
GRANT SELECT ON TABLE public.jobs_public TO authenticated, anon
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS jobs_public_read_all ON jobs_public

CREATE POLICY jobs_public_read_all ON jobs_public
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated, anon
  USING (true)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS jobs_public_posted_at_idx ON jobs_public (posted_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS jobs_public_city_idx ON jobs_public (city)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS jobs_public_job_type_idx ON jobs_public (job_type)
ALTER TABLE resumes ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS file_path text
ALTER TABLE resumes ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS file_name text
ALTER TABLE resumes ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS content_text text
ALTER TABLE resumes ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS analysis jsonb
ALTER TABLE jobs_public ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ingested_by text
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.jobs_public_ingest(jsonb, text) FROM PUBLIC
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.jobs_public_ingest(jsonb, text) TO authenticated
COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.jobs_public_ingest(jsonb, text) IS '岗位广场推送通道：SECURITY DEFINER 唯一写入口，内置配额/挡板/去重，仅 authenticated 可调'
DELETE FROM jobs_public
